title: KIKIORI user guide
intro: KIKIORI is a workspace for organizing field knowledge through AI-assisted interviews.

navigation.title: Choose a knowledge area
navigation.description: Choose a knowledge area from the navigation on the left. The user menu also provides display language and settings.

interview.title: Run an interview
interview.description: Review AI questions on the interview screen and send answers with text or voice.

knowledge.title: Review results
knowledge.description: Review answers, extracted candidates, and record status in the interview screen and knowledge panel.

review.title: Manage knowledge
review.description: Review or edit records and knowledge settings as needed, then have a person review the content before using it.
